title: Role of laser ablation synthesis parameters in ORR electrocatalytic performance of MOF-derived hybrid nanocomposites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25707-25716
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04056F, Paper
Open Access

Mahshid Mokhtarnejad, Erick L. Ribeiro, Soheil Almasi, Bamin Khomami
This study presents a rapid, eco-friendly, and scalable method for fabricating non-precious metal electrocatalysts for the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR) using Laser Ablation Synthesis in Solution (LASiS).
